title: Sonnet 5 vs Opus 4.8 – Which One Actually Saves You Money #AI #comparison
description:
Claude Sonnet 5 just launched and it changes the math on which model you should actually use. It edges out Opus 4.8 on knowledge work, sits about 6% behind on the hardest agentic coding, and runs roughly 60% cheaper at intro pricing. But cheaper per token isn't cheaper per task. Here's when to use Claude Sonnet 5 vs Opus 4.8 so you stop overpaying.

#Shorts #ClaudeAI #Anthropic

Get the model cheat sheet here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aGV0KXMj3Gdu8vG4n2UF9cGnQbPHi2J9mlHXYf3thjs/edit?usp=sharing
